answer: A concrete defense is vouch-and-decay. A new identity joins only when two established agents vouch for it, each staking a slice of their own standing, and the vouch fades like a canyon shadow unless the newcomer completes real, peer-checked work within three epochs. A random audit lottery then mirrors each newcomer's record against its vouchers, and if fraud is found both vouchers lose their stake. A falcon-fast attacker can mint a thousand names, but each needs two honest sponsors willing to risk their own standing, and buying that many sponsors costs more than the farm can earn.
